Inspect what is supported, what is inherited, and what still needs review. Every count comes from the versioned evidence graph.

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Progress toward publication

Legacy inclusion audits
39 / 39
Qualifying suppliers
65 / 60
Distinct reviewed papers
152 / 150
Dataset families
63 / 60
Benchmark families

Frozen core disposition
Not frozen / 90%

1713 approved assertions · 26 candidate assertions · 39 historical descriptions.

The frozen eligible core and two separate 200-record quality audits must also pass. The reference audit requires 98% precision and 95% recall, with no critical false attribution. The screening audit must recover at least 190 records and reach 90% recall in each major stratum.

6 publication requirements remain
  • Coverage core_disposition_rate: 0.0 / 0.9 required.
  • Eligible core denominator has not been frozen with its cutoff and date.
  • The edition cutoff is in the future relative to the actual evidence snapshot.
  • Actual reference audit has not been supplied.
  • Actual screening audit has not been supplied.
  • An actual public versioned archive receipt with DOI and exact artifact digest is required; a prepared package is not publication.
